36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
181708: A beautiful elf Zagan bought for one million gold coins. She is wary of him at first but later on feels comfortable by his side, and is able to understand him despite when he cant properly express his feelings.
181709: A young but powerful mage who is one of the candidates to be a "demon lord." He is a handsome eighteen-year-old, that later on buys an elf slave due to falling in love with her at first sight.
181710: Zagan's partner in crime, that is to say, his only friend. He is also as powerful or even more than Zagan. He too is a candidate of becoming a demon lord.
181711: A clerk at the store where Nephelia and Zagan buy clothes. She has an easygoing personality.
181712: A young dragon who attacked Zagan to steal his powers because she desires strength.
181713: A woman who is a member of the Angelic Knights, a force of the Chivalric Order that dispenses justice against sorcerers in the name of God.
